subtitle: Family roots, stories and connections
emptyTitle: Every story begins with a root
emptyText: Open an encrypted archive or enter Admin mode to create your tree.
selectPerson: Select a person to discover their story.
kinshipSelectFromTree: Select a person from the tree
kinshipSelectPrompt: Select a person in the tree to compare.
kinshipIndirect: Indirect relationship through recorded family links
kinshipCousinRemovedMale: Male cousin of degree {degree}, {generations} generation(s) apart
kinshipCousinRemovedFemale: Female cousin of degree {degree}, {generations} generation(s) apart
kinshipNoConnection: No recorded relationship path between these people.
fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen mode is not supported by this browser.
fullscreenFailure: Could not enter full screen mode.
enterAdmin: Enter Admin mode? This local protection is not secure authentication.
removeRelationshipConfirm: Remove this connection? The people will not be deleted.
selectPersonRequired: Select a person from the list.
removeConfirm: Delete this person and all connected relationships?
adminHint: Admin is protection against accidental edits, not a secure login.
savedDataWarning: Enter the archive passphrase. You can choose to remember it encrypted on this device.
treeGestureHint: Drag to explore · Wheel to zoom
publicPasswordWarning: The initial password is public and can be changed in the code.
activeKeyInfo: A key is active in memory. Reuse it or set a new one; a new key re-encrypts the entire archive.
keyChangedNotice: Share the new passphrase with viewers through a separate channel.
photoReplacement: A new photo replaces the current one.
parentRelationshipHint: To link a parent to a child, select the parent in their profile and add “Parent of”.
publishWarning: Only the encrypted archive is published. A write-enabled token is still a powerful credential.
tokenScopeHint: Fine-grained token: limit it to this repository with Contents read/write. Do not use a permanent personal token.
invalidArchiveFile: The selected file does not contain a valid JSON archive.
invalidPhoto: Choose a valid raster image no larger than {size} MB.
passphraseRequired: Enter the archive passphrase before exporting protected photos or publishing.
archiveTooLarge: The archive exceeds the 25 MB limit.
passphraseGuidance: Use a passphrase of at least 12 characters. Remembering it on this device is optional.
plainExportWarning: The export contains unencrypted personal data and photos. Keep it secure. Continue?
gedcomExportWarning: The GEDZIP package will contain unencrypted genealogy data, notes, sources, and all photos and galleries. It does not include contact details. The file is not encrypted; keep it secure. Continue?
gedcomExported: GEDZIP 7.0 package with photos exported in plaintext. Protect it as sensitive data.
plainExported: Plaintext archive exported. Protect the file as sensitive data.
importReviewSummary: The file contains {incoming} people and {relationships} relationships; the current archive has {current} people.
importReplaceWarning: Applying this import replaces the current in-memory archive. This cannot be undone.
nameRequired: First name and last name are required.
cropInstructions: Drag the square to choose the framing and adjust its size before applying.
cropImageNotReady: The image is not ready to crop yet.
cropCanvasUnavailable: This browser cannot process the image.
cropLoadFailure: Could not open the selected image.
cropReady: Crop ready; it will be included in the encrypted archive.
clearImageCacheConfirm: Clear generated image variants from this browser? The family archive will not be changed.
imageCacheMemoryOnly: The persistent image cache is unavailable or full; this session will use a temporary cache.
imageCacheClearFailure: Could not clear the image cache.
photoTestHint: First check the decrypted original in HTML and SVG. Then compare the generated tree-size variant using blob: and data: sources, SVG clipping, and legacy xlink. Nothing is saved to the archive.
photoTestSourceFailure: Could not decrypt or load the original image: {error}
photoTestVariantFailure: The original loaded, but generating the tree-size variant failed: {error}
rememberedKeyFailed: The saved key could not open the archive. Enter the updated passphrase.
rememberedKeyUnavailable: Protected storage is unavailable; you can still enter the passphrase manually.
rememberedKeyForgotten: Saved key removed from this device.
